header: Sections and their pages, two levels deep
lead: Four to sixty entries in a CSS column flow. An entry without a link opens a section; everything under it is a page in that section and is indented under the heading.
note: The list is maintained by hand rather than generated from the page tree — a scraped sitemap grows every branch somebody forgot to exclude and shrinks whenever a section is renamed.

links.title: Sections flow, they do not break
links.description: With fifty entries a forced break empties half the band
